decisions.reason: As a small accessory with low carrying cost and good fit with the spare-parts and service business, its option value likely still exceeds the cost of keeping it available.
A box car trailer series is close to the firm's core offer and its home-page prominence suggests strategic relevance, so despite higher carrying costs it is more likely retained than withdrawn.

The car transporter trailer is a narrower, more specialized option with higher complexity and by 2022 enough time has passed for weak demand to be visible, making redeployment of resources more attractive.

The low-bed trailer series appears to be an important professional-use extension of the core trailer range, and its established visibility argues for keeping it unless performance clearly disappoints.
A high trailer cover series is a complementary add-on with relatively low ongoing commitment and strong cross-selling logic, so management would typically preserve this option.
Although another box car trailer series raises some overlap risk within a crowded portfolio, it still sits in the firm's main business and is therefore slightly more likely to be kept than cut.
